payload.rationale: BONOBO is well-suited for your request as it infers sample-specific gene-gene co-expression networks and provides matching p-value matrices for each edge. This aligns perfectly with your requirement for a p-value for every edge in the co-expression networks derived from your 14 samples. It utilizes Bayesian shrinkage estimation, which is effective for handling the variability in sample-specific data.
